# Column-convex king-lattice animals (polyplets) passing the "bottom-row-
# waived" cone-reachability predicate (every cell reached in the 5-step
# forward cone {W,NW,N,NE,E} from a source set seeded at every column whose
# bottom equals the animal's global minimum height, rather than only the
# leftmost such column) -- the RED control from results/directed-cone-
# anchor.md ("control B" / grid column ctrlB), NOT Bacher's multi-directed
# class (the two are incomparable; results/multi-directed.md). Counted by
# cell count n. NOT YET SUBMITTED to OEIS -- staged pending jasonp's
# decision to submit. a(1)-a(250). No OEIS match on the 9-term prefix or
# the full series (experiments/oeis_lookup.py, 2026-08-05).
# Method: cpp/middle_kingdom_tm.cpp mode ccctrlb, a transfer matrix carrying
# height-above-running-minimum as state (O(n^2) states; Proposition 3 of
# results/middle-kingdom-phase3.md is not a local rule on profile steps, so
# unlike the other three column-convex cells the state cannot be collapsed
# to O(n)). n=150 in 5.3s/194MB, n=250 in 66.3s/938MB (gympie, 2026-08-05);
# validated against the independent brute-force DFS to n=14
# (make gate-king-grid). This is the ONLY column-convex cell of the
# directedness x convexity grid with no closed form: shown NOT rational
# (no recurrence order<=12), NOT D-finite (order<=12/degree<=12, and
# order<=14/degree<=8), NOT algebraic (degree<=8/t-degree<=14, and
# degree<=6/t-degree<=20) -- cpp/prec_guess.cpp, mod-p rank test rigorous
# over Q. mu = 3.811527945110 (12 digits; theta=0); its geometric
# correction ratio times mu reproduces 2+sqrt(2) to 12 digits, the
# subdominant singularity here being the dominant singularity of the
# (dir5, column-convex) cell above it, matching the inclusion dir5 subset
# ctrlB. Full derivation: results/middle-kingdom-phase3.md.
# - Jason H Parker, Aug 05 2026
